articles.title: Tiger Triumph 2026: India & US Begin Joint Military Exercise In Visakhapatnam To Strengthen Defence Cooperation And Disaster Response
articles.description: India and the US have launched the fifth edition of Exercise Tiger Triumph 2026 in Visakhapatnam. Beginning November 2, the joint military exercise focuses on defence cooperation, operational interoperability, humanitarian assistance, disaster response and coordinated multi-domain operations.
